entities.text: High Court Of Orissa At Cuttack
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Heard learned counsel for the Petitioner and learned counsel for the State.

2. The Petitioner is an accused in G.R. Case No.10 of 2023 pending on the file of learned J.M.F.C.(City), Cuttack arising out of Badambadi P.S. Case No.09 of 2023 for commission of the alleged offence under Sections 341/323/294/420/406/506/34 of I.P.C.
3.

Being aggrieved by the rejection of her application for bail U/s. 439 Cr.P.C by the learned 3rd Addl. Sessions Judge, Cuttack by order dated 15.02.2023 in the aforementioned case, the present BLAPL has been filed.

4. It is submitted by the learned counsel that the Petitioner has not been named in the FIR but only because she was working in the company in the name and style of A 2 Z Solution, she has been arrayed as an accused.

5. It is further submitted since co-accused persons have already been released on bail by order dated 01.03.2023 in BLAPL No.532 of 2023, the Petitioner seeks release, inter alia, on the ground of parity.
6. Learned counsel for the State opposes the prayer for bail during currency of investigation.

7. Considering the nature of allegation, release of the co- accused, and in view of first proviso to Rajalaxmi Behera vs State Of Odisha .... Opposite Party on 23 March, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/155989944/
1 Section 437(1) Cr.P.C., this Court directs the Petitioner to be released on bail on such terms to be fixed by the learned Court in seisin.

entities.text: Rajalaxmi Behera vs State Of Odisha .... Opposite Party
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 8. Additionally, it is directed that the Petitioner shall cooperate with the investigation and shall appear before the I.O once every week on such date and time to be fixed by the learned Court in seisin till submission of final form.
Certification of such appearance shall be submitted to the Court in seisin.
While fixing such date and time learned Court in seisin shall be alive to the fact that the Petitioner is a lady.
9. Accordingly, the BLAPL stands disposed of.
10. Urgent certified copy of this order be granted as per the rules.
(V. NARASINGH) Judge PKS Rajalaxmi Behera vs State Of Odisha .... Opposite Party on 23 March, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/155989944/
